#### What type of PR is this?
/kind cleanup
<!--
Add one of the following kinds:
/kind bug
/kind cleanup
/kind documentation
/kind feature

Optionally add one or more of the following kinds if applicable:
/kind api-change
/kind deprecation
/kind failing-test
/kind flake
/kind regression
-->

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
I wanted to use `wait.BackoffUntil` with exponential and saw this document, tried it but doesn't work. It suggests to use in replace of some deprecated function.
I'm not sure if my suggested document is the exact same of previous one. 

<!--

Fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/117829

Any suggestions here would be appreciated. If the PR is not acceptable feel free to close it.
#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
None
```
